facts.text: I am struggling to find relevant sources on instructional design and language acquisition.
I am working on my Master's thesis for the past six months.
My Master's thesis topic is instructional design and language acquisition.
I need help organizing sources into a table or a mind map to visualize relationships between papers, books, and journals.
I have a lot of papers and books to review.
I want to organize sources by theme or category.
I want to group sources by topics including language acquisition theories, instructional design, empirical research, cognitive load management, and technology-enhanced language learning.
I plan to prioritize language acquisition theories and instructional design sources first.
I want help identifying key concepts and takeaways from these sources.
I want help understanding the ADDIE model and how it can be applied to my research on instructional design in language acquisition.
